contract.count_capture: one SDK peripheral count before counter read
contract.counter_update: increment modulo 256, then reload after logs and clear if 255
contract.recovery: count below 2, either handle invalid, advertising unavailable -> cancel role-sync, start fast advertising, log result
contract.rearm: 2000-flag callback, argument 0, delay 0x2800 on nonfatal paths
contract.inconsistency: count below 2 with both handles occupied -> log, osDelay(500), retained assertion details, even stack BLX invalid state
contract.fault_implementation: C call through even address of aligned stack object; no opcode blob or inline assembly

limitations: Fatal probes establish even stack target with Thumb state clear and emulator invalid-instruction rejection, not physical exception delivery or reset.
Private stack addresses/contents, fault-site PC and callback scratch return registers are outside the C contract.
SDK state integration uses prepared connected/central masks; actual SDK atomic operation and flag-count body execute.
Logger, retained log sink, delayed scheduler, advertising start and RTOS delay are modeled; actual C advertising availability executes in the deeper integration.
No physical timing, final application link or boot proof; byte identity is not required by current user instruction.
